rule.title: Automated PII and Credential Masking in Structured Logs
rule.statement: Structured loggers must automatically sanitize and mask passwords, JWT tokens, API keys, credit cards, and personal identifiable information (PII).
rule.rationale: Logging sensitive credentials exposes them to developers, log aggregation platforms, and external observability breaches.
rule.implementation_guidance: Add a Winston format filter that masks keys matching /(password|token|secret|apiKey|authorization)/i.

forbidden.example: logger.info('User login payload:', req.body); // Logs raw user password

source.book_title: Alice and Bob Learn Application Security
source.evidence_quote: Never log sensitive data such as passwords, session tokens, personal identifiable information (PII), or private encryption keys.
